thread:
anya: Quick postmortem follow-up — we pulled a bunch of learnings from the outage this morning. Need owners + timelines for the remediation items and the tests we promised (regression suites, new prompt sets, load tests, chaos drills). Can folks confirm what they can pick up?

mike: I can own the regression suite additions. Will add failing prompts into the nightly run and make a separate lightweight job for long-sequence cases.

jordan: I'll take the incident-driven prompt set curation. Plan: extract 50 offending prompts, label expected behaviour, and add to eval harness. ETA end of week? @mike do you need them earlier?

mike: End of week is fine. If you can drop them as a csv in the evals/incident-sets folder I'll pick them up. Link the GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/4127

sarah: I'll own the chaos drill for KV cache and routing fallback. Proposal: run a targeted chaos drill next Tue 09:00 PT focused on sustained KV eviction + model fallback for 10m bursts. Want eng-sre to coordinate rollback windows.

eng-sre-bot: Incident runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/kv-eviction-runbook — added checklist for pre-drill monitoring.

liam: Infra note — to simulate realistic KV eviction we need a sandbox pool with tuned eviction thresholds. I can provision but need a ticket for capacity.

anya: Liam — can you open CAP-2146 for sandbox GPU pool and link it here? Sarah/eng-sre, if Tue works, lock calendar and we'll announce to runtime teams.

sarah: Will create the drill playbook and post in #incidents by EOD.

mike: Regression plan (short):
```
- nightly/regression (fast): existing suites + 10 incident prompts
- nightly/longseq (parallel, low freq): long-sequence generation stress cases
- gating/check (pre-release): 3 critical evals run on canary
```
I'll open PRs and a tracking GH issue. ETA PRs by Wed COB.

jordan: Prompt set format: csv with columns: id, input, expected_snippet, severity, notes. Example: `INC-2026-001, "summarize...", "should mention timeout", high, "fails when cache miss"`. I'll upload by Fri.

anya: Timelines recap — mike PR Wed COB, jordan prompt set Fri EOD, liam CAP-2146 today, sarah drill playbook EOD today, chaos drill Tue 09:00 PT. If any blockers speak up now.

liam: CAP-2146 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/CAP-2146 — requested 2 nodes, sandbox tag.

mike: blocker: need a small change in the eval harness to accept incident-label severity. I'll add to my PR.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: please add SLO/alert thresholds for the drill to the playbook (latency p95, error rate).

anya: Okay — I'll create a short recurrence in the calendar for monthly incident-driven evals and put this thread's action items into the remediation board. Please add GH/ticket links to your tasks and update the board when done. :thumbsup:

sarah: Added calendar invite and kanban cards.

mike: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5172 (regressions) and https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5173 (harness severity).

jordan: Uploaded prompt CSV to evals/incident-sets/INC-2026.csv and linked GH: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/88

anya: Great — closing the loop here. We'll run the drill, validate new regressions, and reconvene in the post-drill sync. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2024-11-06T14:00:00Z for PRs 5172, 5173 — dry-run started.

anya: Noted. Keep deploy window tight and call it out in #release-war-room if anything flakes.

liam: If the sandbox nodes show memory pressure during the longseq tests, I'll scale + notify.

mike: Will monitor. If flaky, we gate the canary and revert.

anya: Perfect. I'll post follow-up notes in the postmortem doc with owners and links. Thanks everyone. :heart:
